description: This source file provides functions for managing a socket connection to the Open vSwitch Database (OVSDB), including connecting, disconnecting, reading, writing, and setting socket modes.

methods.name: bool msecs_to_timeval(int msecs,struct timeval * tv)
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to a 'struct timeval' for use with select timeout.

methods.name: int ovsdb_socket_disconnect(int fd)
methods.description: Closes the socket connection identified by file descriptor.

methods.name: int ovsdb_socket_set_mode(int fd,int flag)
methods.description: Sets the socket's mode (blocking/non-blocking) using fcntl flags.

methods.name: int ovsdb_socket_connect()
methods.description: Creates and connects a UNIX domain socket to the OVSDB UNIX socket path, setting it to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: ssize_t ovsdb_socket_write(int fd,const char * buffer,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes data to the OVSDB socket.

methods.name: ssize_t ovsdb_socket_listen(int fd,char * buffer,size_t size,int timeout)
methods.description: Checks for incoming data on the socket within a specified timeout, reading available data.
